scope: All-Artin quadratic-envelope flatness for all Abelian deformations of smooth cubic threefolds; explicit homogeneous Casimir quantization; actual same-ring deformation comparison; degree-three propagation and square-zero vanishing. New proofs independently read; sources and primary inputs checked. Not a full independent audit of the entire retained manuscript.

review.definition: O-marked category problem keeps all exact O-preserving equivalences. Full Abel Artin deformations satisfy relative cubic conditions on the Artin test category. Identification with the formal completion of the stronger all-scheme-base-change stack remains conditional on universal saturation/reconstruction; this scope distinction is explicit.
review.relative_veronese: Complete proof checked, including universal polynomial embedding, Cech intersection from P-flatness, nonreduced-base conic lifting, mu2 Isom torsor, grading-scalar sheaf quotient, and H1 versus H2 descent. An independent reading found no substantive error; section reconstruction on the conic was made explicit.
review.pointed_hom: Field Hom-groupoid comparison checked: exact equivalences preserve Serre, even orbit algebra, ample reconstruction, scalar kernel, and trivial pointed 2-inertia. Relative comparison is conditional on explicit C1-C4 over finite-type complex schemes with fppf topology. These inputs are not established over the full 17-parameter family.
review.formal_cubic: DDL all-Artin comparison and O-marking classical 1-groupoid convention retained. Lowen Thms3.14/3.26, Yekutieli Cors7.5/11.2, and objectwise unique lifts independently checked against original sources. The main full-Abel envelope theorem uses constructed-family surjectivity directly, not prior periodicity or the stronger central-pair injectivity theorem.
review.envelope_reduction: All-degree envelope flatness is now proved for every flat Abelian Artin deformation of a smooth complex cubic threefold. Consequently the retained normal-regular cubic kernel and relative Koszul-AS5 proofs apply. This is relative AS over possibly singular Artin bases, not absolute global dimension five.
review.degree_three_obstruction: B3=R^34 direct_sum R/I and I=Fitt_34(B3) retained. Complete nilpotent sorting proof establishes degree-three flatness iff all-degree flatness for nonperiodic quadratic Z-algebras with polynomial special fibre. Independently reviewed. General Koszul deformation principle is established literature, PP Ch6 Thm7.3, not claimed new.
review.rigid_ambient_application: The O-marked four-parameter corollary uses retained rigid-ambient, finite-order THCR, PBW, low-center and regular-tails inputs. Saturation and Serre conditions are justified via the stated balanced dualizing complex and Yekutieli-Zhang local duality. The whole older rigid-ambient proof was not independently reconstructed in this review.
review.retained_results: Existing finite coefficient 41/37 and17/13 constructions, gcd periodicity, finite-order regularity, Poisson component and residual strategy retained. The Artin comparison has been reworked and reviewed here. Other retained calculations and proofs are not represented as newly rerun or fully audited.
review.novelty: DDL/Lowen/Yekutieli/CFT and the Koszul deformation principle are known inputs. Novelty or priority of the full-Abel quadratic-envelope conclusion, square-zero specialization, relative Hom formulations, and their combination remains unconfirmed; no exhaustive priority claim.
review.square_zero_obstruction: Complete proof independently reviewed: Schur residual Theta=delta(q_(i+1)-q_i)=F lambda; delta^2=0 and injectivity on constant three-cochains force lambda=0. Valid for any nonzero cubic, no smoothness, with dim V>=4; written in five-variable case. General Artin I subset m^2 follows by Fitting base change. Nonlinear Jacobi corrections prevent naive higher-order induction.
review.homogeneous_quantization: CFT arXiv:math/0012228v3 §3, Thm3.1, Prop3.3 and Cor5.2(iv) checked. Finite nilpotent substitution, graph-degree preservation, alpha=Pi/2 normalization, quadraticity via split-kernel Nakayama, and central cubic regularity supplied explicitly. Full graded Hochschild/Poisson gauge classification is not assumed.
review.actual_artin_comparison: Relative Poisson functor is prorepresented by T, using lifted polarization, relative bivector/Jacobi calculations and the formal PGL slice; H0(T_X)=0 removes infinitesimal automorphisms. Yekutieli makes Ass represented by the same T. The actual constructed map has injective 20-dimensional tangent map, hence induces an invertible continuous endomorphism of T. No higher agreement of independent quantization coordinates is assumed.
review.central_pair_comparison: Construction proves surjectivity of actual central-pair-to-Ass map. Injectivity uses unique invertible bimodule polarization, section recovery and quadratic envelope. Framed ring is formal PGL24 torsor over T, with scalar stabilizer removed. Proof reordered to avoid circular dependence on graded formality classification.
